SearchText inputsView in Figma

The `m3e-search-bar` component — strict per-component surface.

import M3e
import M3e.Values
These helpers are our examples, not the library

The Doc.* helpers in these examples are this docs app's own module — not part of elm-m3e (they won't resolve from a fresh install). You rarely need anything like them. The library gives you typed components (M3e.*) plus TypedHtml for standard HTML, and you never import HtmlIr: M3e.Element, M3e.Attr, M3e.Node, M3e.Values.Value and M3e.Kind.Supported / .Shared are all re-exported, so every type annotation you need is reachable from the brand. Build layout, text, and links directly from those. The genuine escapes ship with the library too, in one greppable, lint-fenced place — M3e.Unsafe (fromHtml, fromNode, recast, and customElement for a custom tag the types can't express) and M3e.Unsafe.Attributes. See Escapes.

Usage

Typical usage

M3ecomponentbuildHTML
M3e.searchBar [ M3e.SearchBar.clearable True ]
[ M3e.SearchBar.leading (M3e.icon [ M3e.Icon.name "search" ] [])
, M3e.SearchBar.input (TypedHtml.input [ Native.attribute "placeholder" "Search..." ] [])
]
M3e.SearchBar.el { input = TypedHtml.input [ Native.attribute "placeholder" "Search..." ] [] } [ M3e.SearchBar.clearable True ] [ M3e.SearchBar.leading (M3e.Icon.view [ M3e.Icon.name "search" ] []) ]
M3e.SearchBar.build { input = TypedHtml.input [ Native.attribute "placeholder" "Search..." ] [] }
|> M3e.SearchBar.withClearable True
|> M3e.SearchBar.withLeading (M3e.Icon.view [ M3e.Icon.name "search" ] [])
|> M3e.SearchBar.toElement
<m3e-search-bar clearable="">
<m3e-icon name="search" slot="leading"></m3e-icon>
<input slot="input" placeholder="Search...">
</m3e-search-bar>

API
Types
type Is

The kind row m3e-search-bar produces (open — composes into any slot naming it).

type Attrs

The closed attribute-capability row.

type Builder

The narrowed pipe-builder this component's M3e.Build.<X> module exposes.

type AttrCaps

The attribute capabilities this component's builder admits.

type SlotCaps

The singular-slot capabilities this component's builder admits.

type ClearIconSlot

The kinds the clear-icon slot admits.

type LeadingSlot

The kinds the leading slot admits.

type TrailingSlot

The kinds the trailing slot admits.

type ChildAdmittedBy

The context demand this container injects into each child's admittedBy row.

M3eComponentsBuilderRaw
Constructor
searchBar : List.List (M3e.Attr M3e.Component.SearchBar.Attrs msg) -> List.List (M3e.Element childAccepts (M3e.Component.SearchBar.ChildAdmittedBy childAdm) msg) -> M3e.Element (M3e.Component.SearchBar.Is s) admittedBy msg

The loose m3e-search-bar producer — open attribute/child rows, no required record. See M3e.Component.SearchBar.component for the required-content form.
